component.name: Project B
component.summary: A browser with a shell anyone can customise (preview)

description.p: An experiment in browser architecture: a web-based shell anyone can customise, over a small Go core that owns every decision, and Chromium's content layer, unpatched.

This is a preview for Linux on arm64. It follows the desktop's dark mode and updates itself; opening downloads in other apps, notifications and knowing it is the default browser are still being built.
